result.title: Lucas Museum: Top searches reveal hidden narratives | Searching For
result.description:
Step inside the Lucas Museum for an exclusive guided tour with Senior Curator Ryan Linkof. From fine art and comic books to cave paintings and beyond, the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art celebrates the stories that connect us all. Join us as we explore the top searches around universal themes of love, play and family through the lens of visual storytelling. Grab your ticket, it’s time for the next episode of Searching For.

result.title: Celebrating Hispanic Heritage Month
result.description:
Sabor, historia, y puro ritmo 💃 🎶 In honor of Hispanic Heritage Month, the #GoogleDoodle is spotlighting the evolution of Latin pop through the legendary Gloria Estefan and her classic hit “Rhythm Is Gonna Get You.”

From salsa and bachata to cumbia and dembow, Latin pop carries generations of rhythm in every beat, full of history, heart, and the kind of energy you feel before you even know the lyrics.

It’s the rhythm we all get – and the rhythm that gets us all. 

Featuring AJ Ramos, Head of Artist and Label Partnerships for Latin Music & Culture at YouTube Music
